##### Welcome! 
I am a **Data Science Graduate** from the University of British Columbia, Canada, and hold a **Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Engineering** with an **Honours degree in Data Science** from K. J. Somaiya Institute of Technology, India.

With over **2 years of combined experience** in **machine learning engineering**, **natural language processing**, **data pipeline development**, and **applied research** across the **legal** and **agricultural** domains, I specialize in building scalable and reproducible data-driven solutions.

Explore this website to learn more about my [background](about.qmd), [projects](projects.qmd), and access my [resume](files/Ismail_Bhinderwala.pdf).
